name: Toolbars (every toolbar: tap-to-confirm on touch, per-toolbar choices)
description: The Toolbars plugin (Brett, Nov 3 2026): owns every toolbar in the app. Settings → Plugins → Toolbars switches tap-to-confirm on touch (first tap shows what a button does and arms it, second tap runs it; mouse, pen and keyboard click once) and sets the arm window; All toolbars lists every toolbar on screen with its own override. The behaviour is the framework's (react/tapConfirm.ts, installed by AxfProvider).

parts.label: Tap to confirm (touch)
parts.description: On/off for touch and the arm window (default 3 s).

parts.label: All toolbars
parts.description: Every toolbar on screen with its settings id and its own tap-to-confirm choice.
